items.summary: BatchDecodeWithPagedKVCache returns ~98.5% wrong elements on windows-gfx1151 (ROCm 7.14, clang 23) while rope/estimate pass and the same branch passes on gfx1100/gfx90a at ROCm 7.2.3; not aliasing, not -O3 (both rebuilt and retested)

PORT DEFECT (supersedes quest-gfx1151-decode-attn-wrong, which wrongly blamed ROCm). Under HIP __CUDACC_VER_MAJOR__ is undefined, so FLASHINFER_CP_ASYNC_ENABLED is off and cp_async commit_group/wait_group compile to empty, leaving the decode kernel 2-stage smem pipeline with no ordering. Races at >=4 wavefronts per block: wrong on gfx1151, LATENT on gfx90a/gfx1100 which currently pass by scheduling luck. Proven: num_stages_smem=1 gives 121/121; bdz 1/2/4 pass, bdz=8 fails. Fix = shim cp_async.cuh, or force single-stage on the HIP path
